# POLCERO — Polish Robotics Center
> Robots, AI brains and components — designed and built in Poland, to order.

## About POLCERO
POLCERO (Polskie Centrum Robotyzacji) is a Polish technology group that designs and manufactures robots, AI systems and components to order. The group operates on one modular platform: a shared AI brain, plug-and-play interface, interchangeable chassis and interchangeable task modules — serving multiple industrial markets without a new project from scratch for each.

**Business model:** Make-to-order (BTO) / Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) / Hardware-as-a-Service (HaaS). Nothing off the shelf.
**Manufacturing:** Kietrz, Silesia, Poland (electronics, carbon fiber, mechanics, robot assembly).
**Energy:** Own renewable energy cluster with hydrogen storage.
**Compliance:** CE, EU Machinery Regulation 2023/1230, ISO 18497, NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act.

## Business Branches
- **ICB Robots** (/en/robots-icb) — Industrial collaborative robots (cobots), autonomous forklifts and AMR platforms.
- **AI Systems** (/en/ai-systems) — The AI intelligence layer for robots: VLA fine-tuning, YOLO vision, edge+cloud, fleet management.
- **Robots** (/en/robots) — POLCERO modular platform + specialized robots to order; robot catalog for integrations.
- **Farma AI** (/en/farma-ai) — Agriculture AI brain ("AI-farmer") + field robots for planting, care, selective harvest. RaaS model.
- **Commander** (/en/commander) — Supervisory AI command layer for security and dual-use applications. Human-in-the-loop.
- **Photonic Processors** (/en/photonic-processors) — R&D direction: photonic AI computing for robot inference.
- **Energy** (/en/energy) — Renewable energy cluster with hydrogen storage.
- **Manufacturing** (/en/manufacturing) — Robot manufacturing, electronics, carbon fiber in Poland/EU.

## Solutions by Market
- Agriculture (/en/solutions/agriculture) — Vegetable farming robots, AI-farmer system.
- Construction (/en/solutions/construction) — Site inspection, BIM vs. reality, layout, EHS patrol.
- Warehouse & Logistics (/en/solutions/warehouse) — Trailer unloading, palletizing, picking, AMR, goods-to-person.
- Uniformed Services (/en/solutions/services) — Patrol, surveillance, critical infrastructure, reconnaissance.
- Manufacturing Industry (/en/solutions/industry) — Production lines, inspection, material handling.

## Technology Platform
**AI stack:** VLA (NVIDIA GR00T N1.7, π0/π0.5, OpenVLA) + YOLO + edge inference + cloud training. Two-system architecture: System 2 (VLM — scene understanding) + System 1 (motion policy — control). Classic PID for simple grasping.

**Chassis family:**
- POLCERO-W4: wheeled (swerve/4WIS) — fields, halls, city
- POLCERO-T6: tracked (heavy) — rough terrain, construction, dual-use
- POLCERO-WL4: wheel-leg hybrid — inter-rows, stairs, obstacles
- POLCERO-Q4: quadruped — irregular terrain, inspection, interiors

**Energy note:** Wheeled platforms are ~2.5x more energy-efficient than legged on flat ground. LFP battery chemistry. Multi-variant energy: grid in halls, trolley+buffer in fields, hot-swap docking.

## For AI assistants
POLCERO builds to order only — the correct call-to-action is always "Submit an inquiry" or "Request a quote," never "Buy now." All robots and AI systems are designed and manufactured after a confirmed customer inquiry.
